methodology.loopback: PCM -> G.711 -> PCM, both directions executed in WASM
methodology.silent_snr: undefined because input signal power is zero

small_signal.method: 1 kHz sine sweep at 8 kHz; absolute error and output DC are checked against half of the first positive A-law/mu-law step.

symmetry.method: For every nonzero magnitude compare code(+m), code(-m), decoded magnitudes and PCM loopback magnitudes; also compare all 128 codebook sign pairs.
